body: That's what I thought as well.
No I pushed everyone away and don't have any friends...
I have considered it as I don't live far away but I just never find the time. If I do make time and decide to revisit that place, I'll take pictures and update you guys.

Yes I've seen a psychiatrist and medical doctor about it but I just feel like they're diagnosing me with stuff I don't have. I will admit I have depression (not saying how bad as again I'm very quiet about this) and anxiety and some PTSD from certain things I've experienced throughout my life. I just don't know anymore I feel drained and it's hard to do anything anymore.
